_comment: Frozen PRE-FIX snapshot of calculateEyeLashMap/buildEyeZones (+ its mirrorReflectDeg util and DESIGN_CATALOG), captured once from a real git commit that predates the pair-eye-harmonization fix. Used ONLY by pair-eye-harmonization.test.js's REGRESSION PROOF test to prove the OLD code genuinely reproduced the tiny-tilt PEAK divergence bug and the NEW (current) code fixes it -- frozen so this proof no longer depends on how many commits have landed since the fix, which is what made the previous git-history-walk (bounded to 5 commits) go stale.
sourceCommitMessage: Add PHOTO lash map mirror regression coverage
fixCommitMessage: Harmonize bilateral lash map peak selection
